name: Geek'd Extracts - Dabbit Hash Hunter - Tropicana Cookies - THCA + 20x THCP Cartridge .5g - Sativa
description:
Energize with Hash Hunter Tropicana Cookies THCA cartridge. This .5-gram 510-thread cart packs extreme potency THCA dabs + 20x THCP for dab-like effects in a convenient format. Sativa strain with zesty orange and tropical cookie flavors delivering uplifting, euphoric energy. Infused with strain-specific terpenes and hemp-derived live resin. Compatible with any 510 battery for smooth, powerful vaping. Farm Bill compliant maximum potency formula for daytime creativity and focus.

Details

• Tropicana Cookies (Sativa)

• .5g Gram Cartridge

• Live Resin Blend

How to Use

• Connect cartridge to 510 threaded battery powered device

• Activate device and inhale.

• Battery not included

Cannabinoids

• THCA

• THCP

• Delta-8

What is THCA?

THCA is the natural precursor to THC that delivers the classic "high" when heated.

THCA is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in raw hemp, but once you apply a flame, it undergoes decarboxylation and converts into Delta-9 THC. This gives you a potent, authentic cannabis experience that is federally legal under the 2018 Farm Bill.

What is THCP?

THCP Unforgettable High

Experience an unforgettable high with THCP, the most potent THC cannabinoid. THCP offers immediate and highly psychoactive effects that are approximately 33x as strong as Delta-9.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 Is Made From Pure CBD

THC8 (Delta-8) the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. THC8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

Full Panel COA

Tropicana Cookies

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
